notes.title: Experimental Patch
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33873228/ef147031fb5081e9bb47923646b1435a4b66eb7d.png[/img]

We've pushed a new build branch, this one is for the experimental features (if after testing, it's OK, the build will be promoted to the normal branch so everyone will use it).

The code to opt-in is: [b]giang123456789[/b]

The instruction on how to opt-in beta branch: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=380122528

The patch that comes with this announcement has these new features:

[list]
[*] [b]New Special kind of Stickman[/b], each with a unique ability, you'll only encounter from level 20 on, the chance is 50/50 (Base Stickman/Special Stickman). Tell us how many kinds you've discovered.
[*] [b]Hold[/b] your mouse instead of to click to beat the Stickman. You can find it on the Store tab, unlock and upgrade it by AdCoins.
[/list]

P.s, more about the Experimental (beta): you can opt-in/out anytime you want, and you should expect the Experimental branch has more issue (although we always test before pushing to any branch).

Thank you!

notes.title: Hat collector, macOS update and more...
notes.notes:
[b]Good news for macOS gamers:[/b] you are up-to-date now!

The latest update has been available minutes ago, this time both Windows and macOS receive the update. We were experiencing a technical issue that made updating for macOS impossible. Now the problem is solved, and in the future, all the platforms will receive new updates at the same time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33873228/2a8bceda5a0df67a9317b22195564a2c6a989b3f.png[/img]

[b]What's new:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Stickman loves hats! Sometimes it will wear a hat, and sometimes, as it takes damage, it will drop the hat. Just go ahead, collect it for currency reward and collection. In the future update, there may be a new leaderboard for who collect most hats (rarer hats will have the bigger score, of course).

[*]This update also fixed a bug with the Story that caused the storyline's text missing.

[*]From now on, you'll receive daily AdCoins for free.
[/list]

We're still actively working to improve Beat Stickman, all the feedbacks are very welcomed.
